notes.title: Dev Update #8: Slow progress is still progress
notes.notes:
[h1]Development continues![/h1][p][/p][p]The Steam Summer Sale is now over. Huge thank you to everyone that purchased a copy of Bonding, Now! It was a bit of a rough time period for us right now. We've been moving across the country and it's always a big deal, always time consuming, always tiring. I think we settled in right now, but because of that progress on the next update was slow. Which doesn't mean there hasn't been any![/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned in my previous update, my main focus right now is Story #3. It's a detective story, with the gameplay elements focusing on solving 'the mystery at hand'. I'm sure everyone remembers those good old detective games where the player had to gather clues, question suspects - slowly and slowly unveiling the truth. This is basically what it will be.[/p][p]I try not to over-complicate the game mechanics, but I am working on a system for clues gathering and questioning suspects about them. I think complex mechanics in games like these have both pros and cons. For instance, let's say a system where you can ask any character about every glue you have gathered. It's a neat idea, giving the player the chance to feel like a real detective and figure out who to ask about what. But in reality, many players will most likely just brute-force this system, asking everyone about everything. And it might be frustrating when sometimes you really don't know what to ask a character about. So that's not ideal.[/p][p]As of the actual story, let's just say I'm slightly inspired by an old noir crime movie "Laura" from 1944. But only slightly![/p][p][/p][h2]But what about boobies?[/h2][p]
I know you will all like the gumshoeing of Story #3, but I'm sure there's also quite a few of you that prefer the slightly more 'erotic' nature of the stories. I am still undecided about which of my few ideas to pursue next. In the previous dev update I listed out 3 H-related story ideas and I think I like all of them equally. If you feel that one is more interesting than another, please, let me know![/p][p][/p][p]I guess that's it for today. Oh, I also started chatting around the Visual Novel community on reddit - great people there! Why didn't I know of such things existing before? I guess that's the cons of living under a rock.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a wonderful weekend everyone.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update #7: The future, Now
notes.notes:
[h1]Huge thanks to all the supporters![/h1]

I was very happy to see quite a few people purchasing Bonding, Now after release! Thank you! As a single part-time developer it always takes longer to create all the content, so knowing that some gamers decide to buy and experience my long-time-in-the-works creations puts a smile on my face. And of course this motivates me to continue on.

But remember: your feedback is [b]invaluable[/b]. Not only regarding the gaming aspects, but also regarding the stories, the characters, the themes, moods and visuals.
Bonding, Now is a place where I can turn our fantasies into something more physical. I draw a lot of inspiration from the people around me: my partner, my friends, family. And it is a bit of my quirk that I am interested what people think of the characters in those. Who is your favorite? Who do [b]you[/b] think is the most attractive? Which boy is the hottest? Which girl is the cutest? We'd really like to know!

[h2]What next?[/h2]

Now that Bonding, Now is out, first thing I'll have to think about increasing the reach slightly. I'll try to spread the word of Bonding, Now across the internet and gaming communities. I'd love it if more people could join in.

But once that's done, back to game development! I think it's finally time to work on Story #3: Eclipse. For those of you that enjoy nudity: sadly, this story will not have any. I always liked detective/mystery stories, and this is basically what Story #3 is. But I guarantee that if you like crime noir, you will enjoy this one for sure.
Then there's also continuing adding additional days to the open-ended Story #5. But I think I'll be doing that in-between other things, not focusing on this instantly.

I currently have 4 other story ideas ready in early draft stage. I'd love to make them all, but with my limited time I need to choose my battles carefully. Two are my original ideas, one is my partner's and one inspired by original ideas from our friend. Not sure which one I'd like to do, but the general 'vibes' are:
[olist]
[*] Two couples and a nudist beach resort
[*] A gender-swap story
[*] Three-person mystery-filled trip to a rented cabin
[*] Night guard shift at a shopping center
[/olist]

If you have any opinions, please be sure to give me a sign!
Also, if you think any of the existing stories should get a sequel: shout! The more people are interested, the more I will consider that possibility.

Anyway, enough babbling (writing) for today. Consider buying Bonding, Now! And stay in touch! Cheers.

notes.title: Dev Update #6: Bonding, Now is finally OUT!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's release day![/h1]

This will be a rather short developer update, just to pass the good news: Bonding, Now is finally out! This took longer than expected, and there's still work to be done. However, I'm very happy with the end result in its current state.

Important thing to remember: [b]there will be content updates![/b] If there is interest, I will continue expanding currently work-in-progress stories (like Story #3 and Story #5) and adding new ones, with new characters, histories and mechanics. That's the whole idea behind Bonding, Now. So if you're sad that one of the stories is not finalized just yet, let me know!

[h2]Small launch bonus - one-shot manga[/h2]

For release, I also decided to draw something extra. The plan is for this to be a 3-page one-shot manga. First page available now, as a treat! Read it like you would any regular manga (right to left, top to bottom).

This is a little side plot from the adventures in Story #4. If it got you interested, buy the game and try out Story #4! Meanwhile, enjoy the first page of three! Click on the thumbnail to see the full sized page:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202309/ee2cf9b08036952c9598e571badf8d4f159ac6ce.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202309/e4a08a600709028696d6c639052ab6ee2959e42e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Feedback welcome![/h2]

I'm a single developer doing everything: from story, through code to drawing the artworks. All that while juggling a regular full-time job. There [b]will be bugs[/b]! Report those via our Steam forums and/or social media, please!

But don't stop at that. Please, give feedback about which stories you liked most, which characters you considered most interesting. Let me know which stories you'd like to see more!

And if you decide to buy the game: a big [b]thank you[/b], and have fun!

notes.title: Dev Update #5: On the road to release
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202309/e1fc3a265d45b09f6e621263cdcc575818de27f7.png[/img]
Happy New Year everyone! I really wanted to get Bonding, Now ready by Valentines Day... alas, things usually take longer than one originally assumes. Let's start this devlog with some updates.

From good news: Story #4, featuring Nabi and Eclipse, is now completed! This is quite the important milestone as finishing up this story was my number one requirement for release. This means the game is really close to a releasable state!

With this, the game now has 3 fully complete stories:
[list]
[*] Story #1 - the one available in the demo; three friends going on a martial arts camp together. This one features Leia as the main love interest.
[*] Story #2 - two people wake up in a room with no doors or windows. Featuring a the troublesome character of Gretta (not present in Story #5).
[*]Story #4 - a long weekend of a group of four friends, embarking on a fantasy pen-and-paper adventure... and more. The latest addition and I think so far the longest short-story of them all. Features Nabi and Eclipse.
[/list]
Before release what I still need to do is testing and tweaking. This might feel quick and easy, but I already noticed while working on the demo: there's so much tweaking needed, really. We need to remember that the content in Story #1 and #2 is already around 2 years old. Getting back to them after such a long time, I frequently see dialogue and/or scenes that need rewriting or rearranging. But it's good. Such 'baking time' just adds quality.

[h2]When..?[/h2]

So when will the actual release happen? Besides testing, I wanted to add a bit more content to the ever-going Story #5, but not too much more. There's also some 'help' text that I'd like to prepare for each story, but that shouldn't take too long. I think all of this is achievable in around a months time. So I'd say 1-2 months more and it's out!
Around that time I'd like to spend more time on social media advertisement: go out and spread the word of Bonding, Now a bit.

Would love to get a basic achievement system working before release. But I won't block on that; this can come with the next update as well.

This reminds me: I recently created media profiles on both Bluesky and Mastodon. I'm a bit on the geeky side, and I don't really like or use X/Twitter. You can find those here:
[list]
[*] https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@zenco
[*] https://bsky.app/profile/zencogames.bsky.social
[/list]
I'll be posting some less-official updates there. And a bit more frequently too.

[h2]The artsy artwork[/h2]

But at least I think I have all the drawing content finalized, for now. I'd like to use the occasion to address the elephant in the room (and I will multiple times in the future): I [b]really[/b] can't draw too well. I love drawing, don't get me wrong, but to get any more involved scene drawn, I need sooo many references. Seriously, SOOO many references. If you a scene and feel it looks familiar to you, there are high chances that maybe you saw a photo somewhere already that I used while working on it. I try to ask my partner to help me, and we sometimes photograph each-other to get reference angles/poses. But there's stock references from all over the world as well.

What can you do. Maybe one day I get good enough not to need all of this. You are all witnessing skill evolution first-hand here..!

notes.title: Dev Update #4: Release and no early access
notes.notes:
[h1]Holiday season almost here![/h1]

Holiday season is right around the corner, making it a perfect occasion for a project status report. For this update I would like to mainly address two points: the release date and early access.

Work on the game is progressing nicely. though a bit slower than I'd like. That is sadly the problem when working on something as an after-regular-work project. Especially that there was a lot of chaos, deadlines and crunch at work, so it was even harder to find time for drawing, coding or writing for my game. But even though I'm all worn out after work, I try to spend at least a little bit of time for Bonding, Now every day. Sometimes affecting my personal well-being, but as long as my partner doesn't make complain, it's FINE!
Because of this, however, I'm afraid I will not make it in time to release in 2024... It's a shame, since I really hoped I could go live around the holiday season. But I also don't want to rush it. I need time to not only finish the planned content, but also make sure all included stories are as much bug-free as possible.

[h2]Early access... dame?[/h2]

This brings me to my second topic for today: early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202309/658178a6d9d173c2fb0a3d51b103eaf2c4b0c3b8.png[/img]

Not sure if I mentioned it, but even though the game will not be "complete" on release day, I do not want to mark Bonding, Now as early access. The main reason is: Bonding, Now is supposed to be a living project for most of its runtime. This is the power that the 'stories' split gives. The game will launch with a few ready stories to play through, some being work-in-progress and some entirely missing. I want to keep adding more as time goes, trying out new ideas, new mechanics, adding new characters. In my eyes early access doesn't fit here, since then I'd need to keep it labelled as such for years. And what would it mean to be out of early access?
Of course there are also other reasons. Like, as a small creator, using early access removes some Steam visibility.
So please be mindful of this once the game finally goes live. Release day is only the beginning...! I intend to keep adding content for years to come.

Also: I enjoyed drawing this small comic strip for this post. I might make more of them!

[h2]So, status?[/h2]

In the last weeks I was finally able to finish the whole 'Day 1' of Story #5, the more open-ended one. This is a big milestone, as the first in-game day in such simulations is always a bit of an extended tutorial. All the subsequent days will be a bit less time consuming to do (I hope). I also finally got back to working on the final scenes of Story #4. This is the first story where I am experimenting with some animated scenes. Nothing too special, but if people like it, I might consider making more scenes with moving parts. The biggest potential is of course for sex scenes! Minus is, of course, that those take longer to draw. But we'll see how it goes.

Once Story #4 is done, I will of course continue working on the next days of Story #5, but I do have a few other stories lined up. Theme wise those will be: a spooky horror-ish story, a gender-swap story,
a nudist story... I'll think about which one to do first, and if I should do that, or maybe finally spend some time on Story #3.

So much to do, so little time. Happy (soon to come) holidays everyone!

notes.title: Dev Update #3: Beyond the Next Fest
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Next Fest is over! Let's continue towards release![/h1]

A huuuuge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone that wishlisted Bonding, Now or played the demo during the Steam Next Fest! It means a lot to me, [b]really[/b]. I have mentioned this already in my previous post, but this is exactly why I started Bonding, Now: to share my works and fantasies with others.

There is a lot of competition on the eroge and visual novel landscape right now. There's a lot of talented artists, great storytellers and the emerging AI technologies certainly open up a lot of new possibilities. But I still think some people will appreciate this slightly amateur feel in Bonding, Now. I also don't think there's many games with lineart 2-bit aesthetics that I have.
There are three reasons why the game's artwork looks as it looks. The first one is skill. Throughout the years I tried working with color, shading, highlights; maybe it's a matter of tooling (I'm using GIMP for all of my drawing), but I think I'd need much more practice before I'd get to a level that would make me feel satisfied. Second reason is of course time. Adding color, shading, lightening - all of this requires a lot of time, which means who-knows-when I would be able to release my work. The final reason, and the most important one, is that I actually like working with lineart. I think a lot of depth can be presented through line thickness and well-thought shapes. I really like these aesthetics. There's still a lot for me to learn, but I can already see improvements over the years. And I hope you like them too.

[h2]So, what next? Story #4![/h2]

Development continues. Seeing gamers whishlist Bonding, Now gave me the additional motivation boost that I needed. I think I have most of the code ready, at least for the main stories that are currently in development, so I can concentrate on drawing and story-boarding. Short term, my main goal would be to finish up Story #4 as it's very close to completion. I am quite fond of that one, really, and I'd like to maybe write about it a little bit.

The stories in my game are all about the atmosphere, the vibe. I don't know if you, the players, will be able to feel the same things that I do, but there are certain 'feels' I have about each moment of the game. Story #4 was inspired by the four of us: me, my partner and two other friends, ditching a bigger party just to relax in our own company elsewhere. This vibe of us just having fun, drinking, talking, playing tabletop, this is something I wanted to recreate here. There was this slight sexual tension in the air - but in a healthy, friendly way. I hope you had moments like these as well, and that you'll enjoy playing through those once again. Maybe with a sexually satisfying ending, perhaps?
Another special thing about Story #4 is that it has a separate story within the main story. But that's as much as I will say to avoid unnecessary spoilers!

[h2]Wishlist and poll![/h2]

There's so many things I'd love to write about, but I think I wrote enough already! Just maybe on a final note: give the demo a try if you have a moment! You can find it on the Bonding, Now steam page. It's far from perfect, but I think it gives some insight into how the final product will look like. If you like it, please wishlist! Oh, and if you manage to finish the demo, check out the Steam Discussions post about the character popularity poll. It's all preliminary as really there's not enough content to properly get to know all the characters and make an informed decision, but it is a data point. I have a lot of story ideas, and polls like this will help me understand which one I should prioritize next. I'm also interested in everyone's preferences. Interested how those align with my personal ones..!

Thank you and see you next time!

notes.title: Dev Update #2: Demo and Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Next Fest is right around the corner - and so is the demo![/h1]

Not many people know about Bonding, Now for now. And that's fine. From the very start this project never was about becoming the "new popular thing". If it was, I wouldn't be doing a hentai-like visual novel framework for sure. As the developer, I am well aware of what the game is, and what niche it fits in. It was [b]always[/b] about me having fun creating, and possibly reaching a few other people around the world to also have fun playing the end result. If I'm able to find a few happy players that would like to participate in the community, I'll get everything I ever wanted.

But I think it would be nice for more people to know about what I'm brewing here, even if it's only a black-and-white collection of visual novel-like stories. I know nothing about marketing, and in general use social media infrequently. So it will take a while for me to figure out how to reach more people. In the meantime, to possibly get some "free" exposure, I have decided to participate in the nearest Steam Next Fest starting October 14 2024. And the demo build for that event is now ready!

[h2]Steam Next Fest: October 2024[/h2]

I have already briefly mentioned this in my previous developer update. This took a bit of effort, but it looks like I was able to finalize everything that's needed to participate - and to get a demo ready before the Next Fest starts.

It was challenging as it was all done under time pressure, mostly due to my regular everyday work. I totally think it was worth it however. When preparing the demo content I actually did quite a lot of gameplay, story and bug fixes to the parts included. I probably introduced a ton of new issues while at it, but I intend to do some more testing in the coming days to flesh everything out.

The demo will go live really soon.

[h2]Bonding, Now - Demo[/h2]

The demo content includes:
[list]
[*] Around half of Story #1
[*] Almost the whole first day of Story #5
[/list]
I certainly wanted to have more to show for Story #5, but sadly I did not make it in time. The nature of the story, that the player enjoys much more freedom of where to go, what to do, how to react: all of this requires even more time and attention to detail. But I might update the demo with time, at least getting the full first day in Satoshi's vacation trip to all of you wanting to give it a spin.

As I was playing through the demo build, I saw how much progress I did with both story telling and even drawing between, say, Story #1 and #4 (which is still to be finalized). I think this is something each of you will have to keep in mind when playing the game. It's like a living organism. It's changing as I learn more, affected by what's happening around me.
I left things as they are, as I still like both the artwork and the rest. I might tweak it slightly before the official full release though.

But please keep in mind: the demo content should only serve as a demonstration of what the game could be. There's still so much work that needs to be done. But the "feeling" should be the same. A bit of mystery, a bit of slice of life, a bit "more" of erotics. Expect a lot of dialogues about sex.
I also modified some of the assets a bit for the purpose of the demo. Do not worry: as mentioned before, I do not wish to imply any censoring or obfuscation of assets. Did a bit of that for the demo, but only for people not to spoil themselves the fun of the main game by accident.

Enough for today. Still some work to be done. I really hope you'll give Bonding, Now Demo a spin. Once it's out, try it out, leave me some feedback on the Steam!

EDIT: For now I have only prepared the Windows build of the demo, but if I find enough time I'll try to make one for all you Linux users around as well! Soon!

notes.title: Dev Update #1: The story so far
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam page finally live! Welcome everyone![/h1]

It's great to finally get visibility on Steam! I'm super happy, excited but, at the same time, also a bit terrified. I think those are emotions of every developer who's game is nearing its release date. I wanted to start off with a rather quick status report: how much of the game is done, what are the near term plans and what to expect in the future.

[h2]The story so far[/h2]
Bonding, Now has been in the works for quite a long while already. Even though this is basically an RPG Maker visual-novel type game, creating content [b]always[/b] takes time - especially with dialogue and choices. Especially here since I needed to add a lot of custom code for the purpose of various stories! In the end, I get a feeling that it can take up to 2 hours to create meaningful 5-10 minutes of gameplay. And considering the fact that Bonding, Now is only a side project worked on after-hours, progress is slower than one would expect.

That being said, there is already a lot of fun content ready! As a reminder, Bonding, Now is composed of multiple Stories usually independent of each other. You, the players, select which story to play and switch between them freely. So it's easy to track progress of the project by looking at the completion of each story. Let's take a look at that in detail:
[list]
[*] [h3]Story 1: Ronin Camp[/h3]
Story is fully complete and ready to play!
[*] [h3]Story 2: The Room[/h3]
Also complete, although this story is a bit shorter than the others.
[*] [h3]Story 3: Eclipse[/h3]
This one is still in progress, and will probably be finalized after release in following updates.
[*] [h3]Story 4: Game Master[/h3]
This one is nearing completion, I'd say it's 90% there. Still needs some content and artworks drawn, but it's close.
[*] [h3]Story 5: Summer Bonds[/h3]
This one is still in progress as well, but the idea here is to continuously work and improve. This story is a bit different than the others, as it's my experiment of making an old-school dating simulator, where the player is given more freedom on what to do and with who. For release, I expect only limited playability here.
[/list]
[h2]Upcoming plans[/h2]
Top three priorities in the next weeks are:
[olist]
[*] Finalizing Story #4
[*] Making day 1 from Story #5 fully playable
[*] Constructing a demo for the upcoming Next Fest on Steam!
[/olist]
As mentioned, Story #5 is a bit special. Since it is more of a dating simulator than the usual visual novel 'linear' gameplay, there is time flow and various events taking place at different times of day. I expect to have day 1 fully finalized by the time of Next Fest. But before official release I'd like Story #5 to have at least a week of ingame play ready - but we'll see how it goes.

Then I would finally like to spend more time on Story #3. It's also a 'special' case, different than others, as there will be no sexually explicit scenes in that one. It's more of a classic, old-school detective story, where the player will be gathering clues, talking to suspects. A mix of detective, mystery, noir and occult. The amount of artwork needed there is lower, but I want to spend some uninterrupted time to make the experience proper.

[h2]The future[/h2]
As mentioned on both the steam page and the game website, Bonding, Now is like a medium for visualizing my (and my partner's) fantasies. Because of that, the plan is to constantly add new stories throughout the life of the game. In my mind I already have at least 3-4 additional stories prepared. Some of those finally depict non-heterosexual couples, something I would like to put much more emphasis on in the game. And one of these stories is played from the point-of-view of a female protagonist too!

Throughout the years, I drew a lot of artwork, manga and even created such short game stories like visible in this game - and all of those were exclusively only for me, my partner and closest friends. It is something I was doing since I learned how to draw. Now I wish to continue that, but opening up to others as well! And I hope you'll all enjoy those.

I'd like to write a bit more about my motivations, about the whole concept. But I think that's enough for today. Let me follow up with a separate post with just that.

Nice to meet you and hope you enjoy the game soon! Please join the community and wishlist the game - if you're interested of course! Cheers!
